heading.title: Powers of Superior Officers of Police and Aid to the Magistrates and the Police

article.title: Aid to person, other than police officer, executing warrant
article.content: When a warrant is directed to a person other than a police officer, any other person may aid in the execution of such warrant, if the person to whom the warrant is directed be near at hand and acting in the execution of the warrant.
article.html:
32Aid to person, other than police officer, executing warrant

Section 32 · Chapter IV

When a warrant is directed to a person other than a police officer, any other person may aid in the execution of such warrant, if the person to whom the warrant is directed be near at hand and acting in the execution of the warrant.
